Olufemi — Investing & Trading

Invest with intent. Trade with clarity.

One account that opens the world's markets — shares, bonds, ETFs and funds — with a platform for considered long-term investing and a platform for active trading, side by side.

Service that answers

A named support team and clear, plain-English help whenever markets — or questions — move.

Global markets, one login

Major exchanges across the UK, Europe, the US and Asia-Pacific from a single account.

Support around the clock

Help aligned to global market hours, so you're covered whenever you choose to trade.

Trust

Our reputation is built on trust — and kept by transparency

Trust isn't a slogan here. It is published pricing with no hidden charges, clear statements of what things cost before you commit, and honest communication when markets are difficult — not just when they're kind.

  • ✓
    Pricing in the openEvery fee shown before you trade, in plain language — never buried in footnotes.
  • ✓
    Your money, clearly heldClient money and assets held separately from the firm's own, explained in full before you open an account.
  • ✓
    Risk, stated plainlyEvery product page explains how it can lose value — before it explains how it might grow.
